senses.gloss: ? Stimitarājan (based on a single inferior ms. which reads Stimira-rājāḥ; other mss. Timi-rājan or, with metathesis, Miti˚; stimita seems not recorded in Buddh. literature; very doubtful), n. of a former Buddha: Mv 〔i.141.1〕.
stīna (= Pali thīna; 〔§ 3.115〕) = styāna, q.v.: -middhaṃ, v.l. of Kashgar rec. for SP 〔335.6〕 (vs).
